sources: Ukrainian Air Force; Belgorod regional governor Alexander Shuvayev via Reuters; Ukraine State Emergency Service; Kyiv Independent; Russian Defence Ministry
fault_line: Are cross-border drone strikes on cities legitimate warfare or attacks on civilians? Kharkiv rescuers hit twice while fighting fires vs Belgorod apartment blocks hit.

sections.what_happened: Overnight Oct 24-25: Ukraine's Air Force says Russia launched 153 Shahed-type drones (92 jet-powered, plus Banderol/Dan-T/Gerbera/Parodiya decoys) from Bryansk, Oryol, Kursk, Millerovo, occupied Donetsk and Crimea; 119 downed/suppressed by 08:00, 9 still airborne, impacts at 15 locations, debris at 9 more. Kharkiv: shopping centre and business hit, then a second strike on responding crews — 4 injured incl. 3 rescuers, a fire engine destroyed. Vinnytsia: drone hit a 5-storey residential building, 6 injured (1 hospitalised), 4 apartments destroyed, a private nursing home damaged, 15 residents evacuated, partial blackout. Past-day Ukraine totals per Kyiv Independent: 8 killed, 51 injured. Russia side: Reuters reports Belgorod city 2 killed/13 injured (30 blocks of flats, 35 cars damaged) plus 1 killed/1 injured near Shebekino = region total 3 killed/14 injured; Bryansk minibus attack 2 killed/2 seriously injured. Russian MoD claims 532 Ukrainian drones intercepted over 25 regions, Kharkiv logistics sites hit, and a dry-cargo vessel carrying supplies for Ukraine struck en route to Chornomorsk.
sections.what_verified: Reuters Belgorod region totals converge with the governor's damage account; Ukrainian Air Force + SES + Kyiv Independent converge on Ukrainian-side figures; La Repubblica/ANSA via aggregator match the Kharkiv (1 dead, 4 injured) and Belgorod (1 dead) deaths
sections.what_disputed: Russian MoD's 532-intercept claim covers 25 regions and a different scope than Ukraine's 153-launch wave count, so the two numbers are not directly comparable; the Chornomorsk cargo-vessel strike is MoD-only and unverified. Early Belgorod figures shifted across the morning (Izvestia: 1 killed/10 injured; governor via Max: 1 killed/14 injured; Reuters region total: 3 killed/14 injured incl. Shebekino) — the Reuters region total is the latest and broadest and supersedes the earlier city-only figures.
sections.why_matters: The drone war hit rescuers and apartment blocks on both sides in a single night — lead with the verified numbers, both capitals' claims labeled, no side's tally presented as the whole truth.
